name: Bedrock / Vertex / Azure
summary: The three big clouds each host frontier and open models behind their own APIs: Amazon Bedrock on AWS, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI) on Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry on Azure. Usage is billed on the existing cloud account and runs under that cloud's identity, networking and compliance controls.
facts: Amazon Bedrock: Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI and open-weight models
Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI successor, Apr 2026): Gemini and Claude
Microsoft Foundry (renamed from Azure AI Foundry): OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI and more
Charged to the existing cloud account and commitments
Cloud IAM, private networking and regional data controls
goodFor: Enterprises with cloud commitments to burn down
Keeping data and IAM inside an existing cloud
Procurement-friendly access to Claude and GPT models
watchOut: Each cloud has its own API shape and quotas
